mechanism: Senna as a stimulant laxative reduces gastrointestinal transit time, potentially decreasing B12 absorption in the terminal ileum where intrinsic factor-mediated B12 uptake occurs.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients using chronic senna therapy; separate administration timing if possible (B12 dosing away from senna use) and consider alternative laxatives if B12 deficiency develops.
